description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You or a creature within 10 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

To well-programmed nanites, a body is simply another array to assemble. The triggering creature and its equipment are engulfed in a thick nanite mist and vanish, reappearing in a free space within 30 feet. The target remains at 1 Hit Point, gains a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute, then becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Wounded]{Wounded 1} or increases the value of its wounded condition by 1.
